resolution.title: Task views and resolution
resolution.notice: Use recorded task contracts, exact abstractions and independent tests. Read an authorized WorldView before submission. A declared guard or assurance is not an online verdict, and a view never grants permission to execute.
resolution.queryType: Readable exact object or relation type
resolution.queryNotice: Read up to 100 rows and the selected type's declared fields authoritatively. This bounded view is not the whole world; coverage and truncation remain in its receipts.
resolution.viewNotice: Only actual returned facts and references are shown. Empty actions or abstractions do not mean retrieval has been implemented or that there are no possible actions.
resolution.noAbstractions: No authorized abstractions were returned for this task. Do not invent an identifier or substitute a diagram.
resolution.declaredNotVerdict: These are the contract's declared guard, dependencies, invariants and fallback—not current pass results. Tested does not imply general equivalence. Runtime rechecks the original basis and authorization before execution.
resolution.executionNotice: Submission may execute the task's permitted effects. Acceptance is not completion. If delivery becomes unknown, retry only the exact original request; inspect the original operation for failure, fallback or terminal outcome.
resolution.confirm: Submit this exact task, abstraction, test and input to the selected existing native session? Current scope, dependencies, guard, permissions and budget are checked by World; permitted task effects may occur.
resolution.mismatch: The response does not match the selected world, task or exact revision. Read it again.
resolution.failed: The task view or resolution is not confirmed. Read current information and the original operation.
resolution.sessionNotice: Choose a real session from this Host's local OpenClaw or Matcha Agent catalog. Sessions without an exact native ID cannot be submitted. Selection neither creates a session nor grants permissions.
resolution.sessionUnavailable: The native session catalog is not ready. No session identity has been substituted.

abstractionAuthor.title: Record an abstraction from an exact strategy
abstractionAuthor.notice: This mode records an abstraction without changing definitions. It inherits the exact strategy you confirm, not a generated guard or plan. World derives the candidate and branch; recording does not publish a release or prove equivalence.
abstractionAuthor.strategy: Strategy from the current compilation basis
abstractionAuthor.confirmInheritance: I confirm this exact strategy reference, guard, parameters and steps will be inherited unchanged.
abstractionAuthor.originalsNotice: The selected strategy is included explicitly. Select additional exact definitions to read during resolution; selected action contracts become declared applicable actions. Their real dependencies are checked by World.
abstractionAuthor.bindingNotice: Confirm each parameter separately. Each supplied value binds one explicitly named slot, with cardinality 1..1 and inverse scope equal to the displayed task scope. Objects and relations must come from the actual view; other values are typed literals. No transforms or additional binding guards are added.
abstractionAuthor.basisRequired: First read a task view from the current base release, without a branch. A view from an inspected abstraction is not the authoring basis; clear the abstraction selection and read again.
abstractionAuthor.bindingConfirmed: This exact binding is confirmed. Editing its fields clears confirmation.
abstractionAuthor.omitConfirmed: Omitting this optional parameter is confirmed.
abstractionAuthor.noParameters: The selected strategy declares no parameters. Confirming inheritance explicitly confirms that there are no parameter slots to bind.
abstractionAuthor.noExtraClaims: I declare no additional assumptions or preserved invariants. I confirm no transforms or extra binding guards, and retain the actual view's read dependencies.
abstractionAuthor.expand: Replan with an exact concrete strategy
abstractionAuthor.concrete: Exact concrete fallback strategy with matching parameters
abstractionAuthor.evidence: Evidence referenced by the selected definitions
abstractionAuthor.noEvidence: The selected definitions expose no evidence references. Evidence-request fallback cannot be submitted with an invented or empty evidence set.

assurance.guarded: Guarded — runtime rechecks the inherited guard
assurance.verified: Verified — only the backend formal checker can certify

abstractionAuthor.assuranceNotice: This is a requested assurance, not a successful verdict. Tested requires real completed reports for this task and backend verification of the exact branch and plan witness; an accepted report alone is insufficient. Verified may be rejected if no formal proof is available.
abstractionAuthor.noOp: Only record the abstraction: explicitly submit NoOp and do not change definitions.
abstractionAuthor.reason: Non-empty reason for recording without a definition change
abstractionAuthor.confirm: Submit this exact strategy, confirmed bindings, fallback, requested assurance and explicit NoOp reason? The original operation determines completion; World creates candidate and branch identities.
abstractionAuthor.submitted: Recording requested for {{id}} · {{revision}}. Acceptance is not creation. Read the original operation, then read the exact contract after it completes; unknown delivery keeps the original request.
abstractionAuthor.exactBasis: Resolution basis: release {{release}} · branch {{branch}}. Select a returned exact definition and read a new view; active model revisions are not substituted.
abstractionAuthor.referenceMissing: The object or relation is absent from the exact typed task view. Read it and choose the actual target; do not guess an ID.
abstractionAuthor.slotInvalid: Each bound parameter needs its own non-empty, unique slot ID; required parameters cannot be omitted.
abstractionAuthor.bindingRequired: Enter the exact ID and positive revision, and explicitly confirm every parameter, slot, target or optional omission.
abstractionAuthor.fallbackRequired: Choose an exact compatible strategy or a non-empty set of real evidence references for this fallback.
abstractionAuthor.reportInvalid: A real completed, accepted Tested report and its exact suite for this task are required. World still checks the branch and plan witness.

tasks.invalid: Check the task inputs, suites, and budget.
tasks.importHint: Import an existing complete TaskContract. Its world must match the current world. World still verifies sequential revisions, constraints, and success criteria. The file grants no permissions.
tasks.imported: Complete contract loaded. Review it before registering.
tasks.registered: Task contract submitted. Confirm the outcome using the original submission receipt and task readback.

management.title: Manage installation
management.installNotice: Choose a package ZIP, up to 1 GiB. World verifies its sealed upload, manifest, files and trust policy. A new installation starts disabled with no grants. An upgrade creates a new installation; it does not stop the old one or copy its grants.
management.fileLimit: Choose a non-empty package ZIP no larger than 1 GiB.
management.upgradeMissing: This installation is no longer in the current inventory. Read it again before upgrading.
management.trustNotice: The current policy and the evidence recorded at installation are separate facts. Neither the manifest's requested access nor historical signature evidence proves current authorization or live trust.
management.trustEditNotice: Add or remove publisher signing public keys, or independently permit exact packageDigests for native or trusted-process packages. A packageDigest is the package content digest, not its ZIP transportDigest or the Host executable digest. Only trust code you have verified. This does not install, grant access to, enable or activate a package.
management.publisherNotice: Publisher public keys are signing trust roots for this World, not an official endorsement. Key trust is not limited to one packageDigest: it also recognizes valid signatures on other Wasm packages. allowProcess and allowNative default to false; enabling either permits packages of that type signed by this key, regardless of digest. Both false still retain signing trust. Digests separately permit process/native packages; they do not restrict trust to a key-and-digest pair.
management.policyProgressNotice: Read before editing. Submission checks the policy revision; after a conflict or rejection, read again. Accepted means received, not effective: check the original operation's terminal result and read the policy again. If delivery is unknown, use the original request recovery above; do not submit another replacement.
management.noDigests: No trusted digests in this draft set.
management.digestInvalid: Enter sha256: followed by exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
management.digestDuplicate: This exact digest is already in this draft set.
management.digestLimit: Each trust set may contain at most 4096 unique digests.
management.noPublishers: No publisher signing trust roots in this draft.
management.publicKey: Ed25519 public key (64 lowercase hexadecimal characters)
management.publicKeyNotice: Enter only a public Ed25519 key, never a private key, seed phrase or credential. The 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters are submitted as 32 bytes; World performs the final validity check.
management.allowProcess: Allow process packages signed by this key (any digest)
management.allowNative: Allow native packages signed by this key (any digest)
management.publisherInvalid: Publisher ID must contain 1–256 ASCII letters, digits or -_.: and is case-sensitive.
management.keyIdInvalid: Key ID must be non-empty, contain no control characters and fit within 256 UTF-8 bytes. Case and spaces are preserved.
management.publicKeyInvalid: Enter exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters for a 32-byte Ed25519 public key, never a private key.
management.publisherDuplicate: This publisher and key ID are already in the draft. Remove the original entry before replacing it.
management.publisherLimit: At most 4096 publisher signing trust roots are allowed.
management.policyPreserved: The unsigned-Wasm policy and entries not removed (including their original public keys and flags) are preserved. Removal only withdraws that key or digest trust path; it does not revoke package grants or other trust paths, or stop live resources.
management.policyRevisionLimit: The policy revision cannot be advanced. No replacement can be submitted.
management.policyConfirm: Change the package trust policy for World {{world}}? Compare-and-swap policy revision {{revision}} → {{nextRevision}}, adding {{added}} and removing {{removed}} entries shown in the preview. Public keys are signing trust roots for this World, not an official endorsement; they also recognize signatures on other Wasm packages, not just one packageDigest. False allowProcess/allowNative flags plus a digest permission do not restrict trust to a key-and-digest pair. Review the complete before/after policies, public keys and flags. Other fields and entries not removed stay unchanged. No install, grants, enable or activation will be requested. Check the original operation and read the policy again to confirm the result.
management.readFailed: Could not confirm the current package information. Read it again.
management.lifecycleNotice: These controls submit requests, not a live enabled-state toggle. Enable permits future preparation only; activation and business publication remain separate. Follow the original operation to its terminal result.
management.removalNotice: Disable may retain resources while draining. Uninstall removes the inventory entry only after reference checks; it does not prove state deletion or physical cleanup.

confirm.enable_package: Request enabling {{name}} for future preparation? This does not activate bindings or publish a release.
confirm.disable_package: Request disabling {{name}} and draining its live resources? Follow the operation for completion or retained resources.
confirm.uninstall_package: Request removing {{name}} from inventory? Enabled or referenced installations cannot be uninstalled. This does not delete package state.

management.configNotice: Read the current configuration before editing. Save uses its own revision, not the installation revision. Install-only fields cannot change after activation; existing activation locks keep their exact configuration. Never enter credentials here.
management.configMismatch: The configuration does not match this installation. Read it again.
management.grantNotice: These unchecked choices are a new replacement set, not a display of current grants. Select only the declared access you intend to grant. Confirmation replaces the entire set; an empty selection revokes all package grants. Host authorization is still checked independently.
management.grantConfirm: Replace all package grants for {{name}} with the {{count}} selected entries? Unselected grants will be removed; an empty set revokes all.
management.requestFailed: The package request was not confirmed. Read the current state before retrying.
management.slotCoverage: All fifteen capability slots are listed. Available implementations and nodes in the current activation lock are counted separately; a missing implementation is never substituted automatically.

releases.confirmRollback: Check the target release, current permissions, and bindings, then roll back? External business effects will not be undone.
releases.noHead: The current release head is unavailable. Publishing and rollback are disabled.
releases.empty: No release history is available to read. Start by proposing a change in Models and rules.

review.structureHint: Check definitions, references and compilation structure, separately from business evaluation
review.businessHint: Verify cases, counterexamples and acceptance criteria with a frozen suite
review.confirmPublish: Compare the current release head and publish the selected change? Publishing will not undo external business effects.
review.description: Review the change and its evidence, then validate, evaluate, and publish.
review.empty: No pending changes are available to read. Add source material or propose an update in Models and rules.
review.noOperations: This change has no semantic operations.
review.noEvidence: This change has no additional evidence.
review.validationHint: Validate this revision first, then evaluate it independently with a frozen suite.
review.staleBase: The base release has changed. Rebase and check conflicts before proceeding.
review.publishHint: Requires a publishable revision and its completed, accepted report. Release identity, evidence, and permissions are checked again when publishing.
review.noReports: No independent evaluation reports are available to read.

reports.title: Independent evaluation reports
reports.description: Review actual results, independent criteria, and coverage gaps.
reports.empty: No evaluation reports are available to read. If a validated branch exists, choose a frozen suite to start evaluation.

readback.title: Read source and parsed content
readback.notice: Read exact identifiers from this receipt or draft through World. Parsed text is displayed as data only, never executed. Coverage gaps and source anchors remain visible; an import receipt is not evidence that parsing was complete.
readback.mismatch: The content does not match these exact source and artifact identifiers. Read it again.
readback.failed: Could not read the current authorized content.

materials.title: Material sources
materials.draftAvailable: A material draft is ready for review.
materials.noPolicies: No policies are available. Configure a business scope and its policies first.
materials.fileTooLarge: The file exceeds 256 MiB. Choose a smaller file.
materials.empty: No materials yet. Select “Add materials” to begin.

budget.title: Processing limits
budget.hint: Processing stops at a limit and keeps confirmed results. Limits are not increased automatically.

wiki.hint: Choose a retained version to copy. The original Wiki remains unchanged.
wiki.loadProjectsFailed: Could not load Wiki libraries. Try again.
wiki.loadDirectoryFailed: Could not load the directory. Try again.
wiki.loadVersionsFailed: Could not load file versions. Try again.

draft.title: Review draft
draft.hint: Choose a task, then submit the changes for review.
draft.compileDescription: The entire batch uses the same target binding. Select and confirm external contracts separately for each candidate.
draft.readsRequired: More materials need to be read before submission.
draft.baseChanged: The current version differs from the draft's basis. Process the materials again against the current version.
draft.noTasks: No related tasks are available in this scope.
draft.responseMismatch: The draft response does not match. Check again.
draft.loadFailed: Could not load the draft. Try again.

upload.title: Upload progress
upload.pending: The result is unconfirmed. Continue checking the original request.

archive.title: Backup and restore
archive.hint: Verify that the original backup operation completed. Restore accepts only sealed backups from the same world and storage. Deletion does not guarantee physical erasure.
archive.manifestHint: Select the receipt file saved from a completed backup operation. The file contains only a manifest reference; the backup contents must still be in the same storage in the original world.
archive.invalid: Could not verify that this file is a completed backup operation receipt for this world
archive.confirmRestore: Restoring will replace the current business snapshot and wind down existing work. Continue?
archive.confirmDelete: Logically delete this world? Data protected by retention policies will not be physically erased by this action.
archive.pending: Request accepted. Verify the original operation's result in the operation history.
archive.readbackComplete: The current world state has been checked.
archive.readbackIncomplete: The original operation's result is confirmed, but the current world state has not been fully read or has changed. Refresh to check it; do not submit again.

sync.title: Source synchronization
sync.notice: Choose a published source binding for this exact connection revision. A checkpoint describes captured, applied, projected and acknowledged positions; it is not proof that synchronization is currently running. Start and stop are requests confirmed through their original operations.
sync.noBindings: No matching source binding is loaded. Publish its mapping and source authority before starting synchronization.
sync.startConfirm: Start synchronization for this exact published binding? Current authorization and source capabilities will be checked.
sync.stopConfirm: Stop synchronization and drain this binding's reader and acknowledgements? Check the original operation for its terminal result.
sync.mismatch: The checkpoint does not match the selected binding. Read it again.
sync.failed: Synchronization was not confirmed. Read the checkpoint and original operation.
sync.gap: A source gap is recorded. Do not treat these positions as complete coverage.

connections.title: Business connections
connections.name: Name
connections.catalogWorldMismatch: The connector catalog does not match the current world.
connections.catalogFailed: Could not load the connector catalog. Try again.
connections.saveUnconfirmed: The connection is unconfirmed. Check the receipt; if the outcome is unknown, check the original request.
connections.hint: Connect existing data by configuring one read-only resource first.
connections.pluginHint: Configure the plugin's resources and fields. Manage runtime options and private credentials in plugin settings.

replication.title: Logical replication (optional)
replication.enable: Enable transactional snapshots and resumable change streams
replication.existing: Use an existing complete snapshot barrier
replication.createFresh: Create a new slot for the initial snapshot
replication.guarantees: An existing slot needs a durably saved complete barrier. A new slot is created only for the first change-stream snapshot; a name conflict is rejected without deleting or recreating a slot. Reads and polling do not create slots. An administrator must install wal2json. Use one slot per resource; the server verifies capabilities and permissions.
replication.intentRequired: Choose the initial snapshot method before saving.
replication.invalidSlot: Use 1–63 lowercase letters, digits, or underscores for the slot name.

connections.noImplementations: No installed connector matches this business source.
connections.bindingHint: The selected declaration is used to check capabilities; saving does not pin an installation. Discovery and sync use the published version's exact bindings and verify current permissions.
connections.ambiguous: This provider has multiple installation declarations. The published graph must have one matching node, or discovery and sync are rejected.
connections.credentialsHint: Credentials are kept private. Saving does not mean data has been synced or verified.

discovery.title: Source schema
discovery.hint: Read the current schema revision before each discovery. Discovery does not create mappings or approve source authority; the server verifies the scope and resource against the original connection.
discovery.noSchema: No schema has been recorded for this source yet.
discovery.noKeys: The schema declares no keys. Do not assume any field is unique.
discovery.incomplete: Schema discovery is incomplete and cannot serve as a complete basis for mapping.
discovery.conflict: If the schema or connection revision has changed, read and check it again before submitting; the latest revision will not be retried automatically.
discovery.mismatch: The source schema response does not match the current world or source.
discovery.failed: Could not read or discover the source schema.
discovery.pending: Schema discovery has been accepted. Check the original operation's result in processing records, then read the current schema.

authoring.title: Branch source mapping and authority
authoring.hint: Read the exact revision of the selected branch first. Only branches currently in the proposed state are supported. Saving a mapping, independent approval, and publication are separate steps; reading does not grant approval.
authoring.model: View this branch's binding and target model
authoring.savedMapping: This revision's mapping is saved and cannot be overwritten. Schema changes require a new model change proposal; the revision is not upgraded automatically.
authoring.mappingHint: This branch's model fixes the keys, source fields, target properties, transforms, and relationship roles. Review missing-field, null, formula, and deletion handling before saving. Missing fields, null values, and formulas reject the record by default; source record deletions require reconciliation.
authoring.delete: When a source record is deleted
authoring.invalidMapping: The binding, schema, or target references cannot form an exact mapping. Correct the model or read it again; fields and revisions will not be guessed.
authoring.approved: This branch has independent approval. This does not mean it has been validated or published.
authoring.draft: This draft has not received independent approval for this branch. Review its scope, validity period, and authority ownership.
authoring.confirmMapping: Save the current mapping for binding {{binding}} to branch {{branch}} / {{revision}}? Once saved, this revision cannot be overwritten. Saving does not automatically approve or publish it.
authoring.confirmAuthority: Approve the source authority body, validity period, and ownership shown for binding {{binding}} in branch {{branch}} / {{revision}}? The draft itself is not approval; the server must still verify authorization for this request.
authoring.failed: Could not read or submit the branch source configuration.
authoring.mismatch: The branch source context does not match the current world, exact branch revision, or binding reference.
authoring.chooseBinding: Select a source binding from this branch
authoring.noBindings: This exact branch has no source bindings for the current connection. Bindings will not be filled in from the currently published version.
authoring.conflict: If the branch, model, permissions, or connection has changed, refresh the catalog and read it again before reviewing and submitting. The latest revision will not be substituted automatically. After acceptance, check the original operation in processing records, then return here and read again to confirm whether the mapping is saved or the source authority has independent approval.

access.title: World permissions
access.hint: Select an administrator permission configuration through the main process, then review the full grant and confirm in the app. The main process retains the file path and original request; this page cannot change the grant.
access.checkOriginal: Reselect the original configuration to verify
access.cancelled: Cancelled; not treated as a failure
access.unknown: Submission result unknown; this does not mean it was not submitted
access.responseUnconfirmed: No confirmable result was received. This does not establish that the submission failed or was rolled back.
access.checkHint: Check the original World, commit ID, and grant ID below. Reselect the same original configuration yourself for the main process to verify; do not resubmit with different IDs.
access.receiptMismatch: The returned identity or commit receipt does not match the current World. The result is unconfirmed.

evaluationSettings.title: Independent evaluation identities
evaluationSettings.hint: The main process selects the administrator's configuration file. This page receives only a safe summary, not private configuration or identity claims. This configures an existing world without initializing it again.
evaluationSettings.isolation: The task executor carries out the task; the independent judge handles protected answers and evaluates results. They use separate identities. Actual access is still checked by the existing consumers.
evaluationSettings.authorizationBoundary: Confirmation submits only the selected configuration. It does not grant permissions to the current user or an Agent. Saving does not establish current availability; management permissions and per-operation rechecks still apply.
evaluationSettings.retentionHint: Case access is checked against the listed policy and labels. The corresponding retention policy determines the retention period. This summary contains only policy references and does not provide or infer a duration.
evaluationSettings.confirm: Submit evaluation configuration for world {{world}} with original commit {{commitId}}? The task executor performs the task; the independent judge handles protected answers and evaluates results, using a separate identity. Actual access still requires verification. This confirmation grants no permissions to the current user or an Agent.
evaluationSettings.checkHint: Keep the original World and commit ID above and read configuration status only. Do not change the file or commit ID, or automatically resend. Not finding saved configuration does not establish that the original commit rolled back.
evaluationSettings.notConfigured: No saved configuration was observed. This does not establish failure or rollback of the original commit.
evaluationSettings.statusUnread: Configuration status has not been checked.
evaluationSettings.statusUnavailable: Configuration status could not be read. Review the safe diagnostic, then read it again.
evaluationSettings.confirmed: Original commit confirmed; current authorization still requires verification.
evaluationSettings.rejected: Original commit rejected. Check its commit ID and safe diagnostic.
evaluationSettings.notAttempted: Submission was not attempted. Review the safe diagnostic.
evaluationSettings.cancelled: This configuration was cancelled. This does not establish rollback of an existing submission.
evaluationSettings.unknown: The original commit outcome is unknown. Read configuration status only; do not submit another request.
evaluationSettings.prepareUnconfirmed: No confirmable configuration summary was received. Nothing will be submitted on that basis; check again.
evaluationSettings.releaseUnconfirmed: Release of the temporary ticket is unconfirmed. This cancellation did not submit configuration from this page; review the diagnostic.
evaluationSettings.responseUnconfirmed: No confirmable commit result was received. Keep the original commit and read status only; do not infer failure or rollback.
evaluationSettings.statusUnconfirmed: The configuration status read is unconfirmed. The original commit identity and outcome are unchanged; read status again.
evaluationSettings.receiptMismatch: The returned identity or receipt does not match the original World and commit. The result is unconfirmed; read status only.
evaluationSettings.statusCommitMismatch: Saved configuration belongs to another commit, {{commitId}}. It cannot confirm the original commit above.

storage.title: Material storage
storage.statusFailed: Could not read local configuration status. Try again.
storage.saved: Configuration saved for verification after restart. The connection is not yet verified.
storage.saveUnknown: The save result is unconfirmed. Read the configuration status before adding another target.
storage.alreadyConfigured: Initial storage is configured. Update its existing credentials instead.
storage.invalid: Invalid configuration. Check the connection details.
storage.saveUnconfirmed: Saving or reading status is unconfirmed. Check local status.
storage.unauthorized: The current window or authorization status does not allow changes to World storage. Sign in or authorize a license in the main window, then try again.
storage.credentialsHint: Credentials stay in private local storage and are not returned in public configuration.

open.title: Connect and enable storage
open.hint: Connect PostgreSQL to enable storage and restore it automatically after restart
open.notConfigured: Storage is not configured — enter a PostgreSQL connection
open.notAttempted: Not enabled — resolve the diagnostic below and try again
open.unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed — check the original request
open.blocked: Wait for the current operation to finish, then try again
open.chooseWorld: Storage enabled — choose an accessible world from the top bar
open.noAccess: Your current identity cannot access any worlds in this storage — ask an administrator for access
open.connectFirst: Connect and enable storage in world settings first

reasons.response-unconfirmed: The connection to the app was lost — check the original request; this does not establish failure
reasons.connection-unavailable: Could not connect to storage — check the connection details and database status
reasons.world-rejected: The world service refused activation — check the diagnostic
reasons.outcome-unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed — check the original request without creating another
reasons.control-rejected: The control channel refused activation — check the original request and diagnostic
reasons.timed-out: Waiting for the receipt timed out — this does not establish rollback
reasons.not-delivered: The control request was not delivered — try connecting again
reasons.unknown-delivery: Request delivery is unconfirmed — check the original request
reasons.host-unavailable: The world service is unavailable — restore it and try again
reasons.protocol-invalid: The service response failed validation — keep the diagnostic and check the original request
reasons.authorization-unavailable: The account or license could not be verified — try again later
reasons.authorization-denied: The current account or license does not allow activation — check authorization status
reasons.configuration-unavailable: Could not read storage configuration — check local configuration
reasons.configuration-invalid: Storage configuration is invalid — check the connection details and diagnostic
reasons.configuration-conflict: A different storage configuration exists — check it without overwriting it
reasons.bootstrap-invalid: Activation preparation failed validation — keep the diagnostic and check the original request
reasons.invalid-request: Invalid connection request — check the connection details
reasons.import-busy: Activation is already in progress — wait, then check the original request
reasons.ready-unconfirmed: World readiness is unconfirmed — check the original request

transfer.title: Migrate material storage
transfer.hint: Choose a target registered by the service. New targets require a restart to register. Migration is not a backup; saving does not switch storage.
transfer.confirmPrepare: Prepare migration to the selected storage? Existing work will be finalized when migration runs.
transfer.noTargets: No targets are registered. Save a target, restart, then read configuration status.
transfer.confirmAbort: Request abort of the original migration? If the target is already active, only committed work will be finalized; no reverse overwrite is performed.

phases.failed: Processing failed; check the original migration

transfer.receiptHint: These are observed control receipts, not independent storage-location facts. Keep the original migration if the outcome is unknown or failed.
transfer.notFound: No saved migration request was found for this world.
transfer.unknown: Migration status is unconfirmed. Check it before creating another migration.
transfer.restartRequired: The target is not registered yet. Restart, then check again.
transfer.conflict: An original migration to another target still exists. Check it first.
transfer.invalid: The request was not sent. Check the world and registered target.
transfer.unauthorized: The current window or authorization status does not allow World storage migration. This refusal has not changed the original migration state.
